items.text: Jacksonville (Wed report; Thu report not yet posted): DNP - DE Travon Walker (rib), RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot), WR Jakobi Meyers (ankle); all three played through injuries Wk9. Meyers resumed practice Thu as Limited and is on track to play (Rotoworld). Limited - G Ezra Cleveland (knee/ankle), C Robert Hainsey (concussion), S Antonio Johnson (ankle), RB Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand), LB Branson Combs (shoulder). Rest days - S Jessie Bates III, DT Jordan Davis (deadline adds). IR - S Eric Murray, DT DaVon Hamilton. Trevor Lawrence starts.
items.source: Tennessee Titans (official Week 10 injury report, Titans vs. Jaguars); NBC Sports/Rotoworld (Meyers resumes practicing Thu)

items.text: Tennessee (Thu practice report): DNP both days - WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), LG Peter Skoronski (hamstring), LB Cody Barton (concussion), LB Anthony Hill Jr. (neck). DNP Thu - RB Tony Pollard (finger/rest, full Wed). Limited - RB Tyjae Spears (knee, returned to practice Thu), S Kevin Winston Jr. (shoulder). Full - RT JC Latham (finger), CB Jaylon Jones (knee), DL John Franklin-Myers, CB Marcus Harris. No game designations yet. Cam Ward starts.
